admission_rule: Discovery only until the same ten-pass, visual-forensics, access and scene tests as the canonical universe are complete.

discoveries.name: Campus UTEC
discoveries.why_it_might_add: A cliff-like teaching section, terraces and circulation can show education inhabiting structure rather than another façade portrait.

discoveries.name: Torre Interbank
discoveries.style_signal: postmodern sculptural high-rise / inclined geometric volumes
discoveries.why_it_might_add: The curved highway response, inclined slab and suspended volume can be tested against actual pedestrian and traffic movement.

discoveries.name: Casa Fernandini
discoveries.style_signal: eclectic architecture with Art Nouveau interiors
discoveries.why_it_might_add: Material modernity, floral ornament, concrete construction and present cultural use could form a temporal-layering scene if access is current.

discoveries.name: Estación Desamparados / Casa de la Literatura
discoveries.style_signal: Beaux-Arts civic infrastructure with Art Nouveau glasswork
discoveries.why_it_might_add: A former transport threshold now organizes readers and cultural activity; the change of verb is architectural, not decorative.

discoveries.name: Edificio Petroperú
discoveries.why_it_might_add: Deep concrete frames and civic scale may support light, repetition and institutional-threshold studies without relying on skyline fame.

discoveries.name: Torre Begonias + Paseo Begonias
discoveries.why_it_might_add: The useful subject is not tower height but how plaza, food, work and visitor flows change the financial-center ground plane.
